translations.idiomatic: Since He Guozong added stone dams inside the three dams, not a drop passes through; with no tail outlet to release water and no gaps to pass silt, the Wen carries sand into the canal and the deposits rise daily.

sentences.zh: 請改壩為徬，建磯心五十六，中留水門五十五，安徬板以資宣洩。

translations.literal: It was requested to change the dam to wing-dams, build fifty-six spur dikes, leave fifty-five sluice gates in the center, and install wing boards to facilitate discharge.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the dams be changed into side structures, with fifty-six spur cores built, fifty-five water gates left in the center, and side boards installed for release.

sentences.zh: 又以不能啟閉，別築土堤，名春秋壩。」

translations.literal: Because they also could not be opened and closed, an earthen dike was separately built, named the Spring-Autumn Dam.
translations.idiomatic: Because they still cannot be opened and closed, a separate earthen dike has been built, named the Spring-Autumn Dam."

sentences.zh: 如所請行。

translations.literal: It was carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved as petitioned.

sentences.zh: 十一年，東撫岳濬言：「東省水櫃，舊有東平之安山湖廢閘四。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Shandong Governor Yue Jun said: "In Shandong's water reservoirs, there were formerly four abandoned locks on Anshan Lake at Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: In year eleven Shandong Governor Yue Jun said: "Among the reservoirs of Shandong, Dongping's Anshan Lake formerly had four derelict gates.

sentences.zh: 自國宗議復安山湖水櫃，重築臨河及圈湖堤，修通湖、蛇溝二閘，並於八里灣、十里鋪兩廢閘間建石閘一，曰安濟閘，俱經修竣，仍不能蓄水濟運。

translations.literal: Since Guozong proposed restoring the Anshan Lake reservoir, they rebuilt the river-facing and ring-lake dikes, repaired the Tonghu and Shegou locks, and built one stone lock between the two abandoned locks at Baliwan and Shilipu called the Anji Lock—all completed—yet still could not store water to supplement transport.
translations.idiomatic: Since He Guozong proposed restoring Anshan Lake as a reservoir, the riverfront and ring-lake dikes have been rebuilt, the Tonghu and Shegou gates repaired, and one stone gate, called Anji Gate, built between the two abandoned gates at Baliwan and Shilipu. All have been completed, yet they still cannot store water to support transport.

sentences.zh: 緣湖底土疏，非圈堤所能收蓄，均宜修防。

translations.literal: Because the lake bottom soil is loose, ring dikes cannot retain it; all sections should be maintained and defended.
translations.idiomatic: Because the lake bed soil is loose, it cannot be impounded by ring dikes; all should receive protective repair.

sentences.zh: 其圈湖堤缺，概停補築，以免糜費。」

translations.literal: Gaps in the ring-lake dike should all cease supplemental building to avoid wasteful expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: As for gaps in the ring-lake dike, rebuilding them should all be stopped to avoid wasteful expense."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年，直督李衛以故城與山東德州、武城毗連，系河流東注轉灣處，向無堤埝，水漲漫溢，勸諭民間儹修土埝，量給食米，以工代賑。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Zhili Governor Li Wei, because Gucheng borders Dezhou and Wucheng in Shandong and lies where the river turns eastward, formerly had no dikes or embankments and floods spread—urged the people to contribute labor building earthen embankments, allotting grain rations, relief through work.
translations.idiomatic: In year twelve Li Wei of Zhili, noting that Gucheng's bend beside Dezhou and Wucheng had no levees and flooded habitually, organized labor-for-rice dike repairs among local farmers.

sentences.zh: 東撫岳濬以德州河溜頂沖，於東岸挑新河、建滾壩，兩岸各築遙堤，酌開涵洞，以資宣洩。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Yue Jun, because the Dezhou river current struck head-on, dredged a new river on the east bank and built a rolling dam, remote dikes on both banks, and suitably opened culverts for discharge.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yue Jun, facing a head-on current at Dezhou, cut a new channel on the east bank, built a rolling dam and flanking remote dikes, and added culverts for overflow.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，御史馬起元言：「直、東運河，近多淤塞。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong Censor Ma Qiyuan said: "The Zhili and Shandong transport canals recently suffer much silting.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year two Censor Ma Qiyuan said: "The Zhili and Shandong canal sections have recently become much silted."

sentences.zh: 尚書來保言：「衛水濟運灌田，請飭詳查地勢，使漕運不阻，民田亦資灌溉。」

translations.literal: Minister Laibao said: "Wei waters supplement transport and irrigate fields; please order detailed survey of terrain so grain transport is unimpeded and civilian fields also receive irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Laibao said: "The Wei water supports transport and irrigates fields. Please order a detailed survey of the terrain so that grain transport is not obstructed and the people's fields also receive irrigation."

sentences.zh: 上命侍郎趙殿最、侍衛安寧，會同直、漕、河三督，豫、東兩撫勘奏。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Vice Minister Zhao Dianzui and Guard Anning, together with the three governors of Zhili, Grain Transport, and Rivers and the two governors of Henan and Shandong, to survey and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: The throne dispatched Zhao Dianzui and Anning, with the canal, river, and provincial governors, to inspect and report jointly.

sentences.zh: 經部議：「東省泉源四百三十九，無不疏通，閘壩亦完固，惟戴廟、七級、柳林、新店、師庄、棗林、萬年、頓庄各閘，或雁翅潮蟄，或面石裂縫，兩岸斗門涵洞，有滿家三空橋雁翅低陷，石閘面太低，應交河督興修。

translations.literal: After ministry deliberation: "In Shandong four hundred thirty-nine spring sources are all dredged, locks and dams also sound; only at the locks of Daimiao, Qiji, Liulin, Xindian, Shizhuang, Zaolin, Wannian, and Dunzhuang—some wing-walls are tide-eaten or facing stones cracked—on both banks sluice culverts, at Manjia's Sankong Bridge the wing-walls are low and sunk, the stone lock face too low—all should be turned over to the River Director for repair.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated: "Shandong's four hundred thirty-nine spring sources are all unobstructed, and its locks and dams are also solid. Only at the Daimiao, Qiji, Liulin, Xindian, Shizhuang, Zaolin, Wannian, and Dunzhuang locks, either wing walls have been damaged by tide and insects or facing stones are cracked; among the culverts and water gates on the two banks, the wings of Manjia Three-Arch Bridge are sunken, and the stone lock face is too low. These should be handed to the river superintendent for repair.

sentences.zh: 又馬踏、蜀山、馬場、獨山、微山諸湖，嚴禁占種蘆葦，南旺、南陽、昭陽諸湖水櫃，僅堪泄水，小清河久淤塞，均宜次第修治。

translations.literal: Further, at lakes Mata, Shushan, Machang, Dushan, and Weishan, strictly forbid occupying and planting reeds; the reservoirs of Nanwang, Nanyang, and Zhaoyang can only discharge water; the Xiaoqing River has long been silted—all should be repaired in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Also, reed planting on Mata, Shushan, Machang, Dushan, Weishan, and the other lakes should be strictly forbidden. The reservoirs at Nanwang, Nanyang, and Zhaoyang can only release water, and the Xiaoqing River has long been silted up; all should be repaired in order.

sentences.zh: 至衛水濟運灌田，宜於館陶、臨清各立水則一，測驗淺深，以時啟閉。」

translations.literal: As for Wei water for transport and irrigation, one water gauge should be established each at Guantao and Linqing, testing depth shallow and deep, opening and closing in season.
translations.idiomatic: As for using Wei water for transport and irrigation, one water gauge should be established at each of Guantao and Linqing to measure depth and open or close according to the time."

sentences.zh: 起元又言，通州至天津河路多淤淺，糧艘不便。

translations.literal: Ma Qiyuan further said the river route from Tongzhou to Tianjin is much silted and shallow, inconvenient for grain ships.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qiyuan added that the Tongzhou–Tianjin reach was too shallow for grain barges.

sentences.zh: 命殿最偕顧琮勘議。

translations.literal: Zhao Dianzui was ordered together with Gu Cong to survey and deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dianzui and Gu Cong were sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 尋議天津溯流而上，設有兵弁，無官管轄。

translations.literal: Soon it was deliberated that upstream from Tianjin against the current there were military officers but no civil jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Inquiry found soldiers posted on the Tianjin upstream reach but no civil superintendent.

sentences.zh: 應增置漕運通判一，駐張家灣，專司疏濬；

translations.literal: One Grain Transport vice magistrate should be added, stationed at Zhangjiawan, specializing in dredging;
translations.idiomatic: They proposed a new transport vice magistrate at Zhangjiawan solely for dredging;

sentences.zh: 把總二，外委四，聽通判調遣。

translations.literal: two platoon commanders and four external deputies, all under the vice magistrate's dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: with two sergeants and four deputies under his command.

sentences.zh: 又普濟寺等四閘屬通州，增置吏目一，慶豐等七閘屬大興，增置主簿一，遇應開挑處，報坐糧廳覈實修濬。

translations.literal: Further, four locks such as Puji Temple belong to Tongzhou—add one clerk; seven locks such as Qingfeng belong to Daxing—add one registrar; wherever dredging should be opened, report to the grain office for verified repair.
translations.idiomatic: Puji Temple's four Tongzhou locks would gain a clerk; Daxing's seven Qingfeng locks a registrar; dredging would be verified through the grain bureau.

sentences.zh: 用鄂爾泰言，建獨流東岸滾壩，並開引河，注之中塘窪，以免靜海有羨溢之虞，並減天津三汊口爭流之勢。

translations.literal: Following Ortai's words, build a rolling dam on the east bank of Duliucun and open a diversion river pouring into Zhongtangwa to avoid Jinghai's worry of surplus overflow, and reduce Tianjin's Sanchakou competing currents.
translations.idiomatic: On Ortai's advice they built a rolling dam east of Duliucun with a diversion into Zhongtangwa to ease Jinghai flooding and Tianjin's triple-mouth current conflict.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大挑淮、揚運河，自運口至瓜洲三百餘里。

translations.literal: That year a major dredging of the Huai-Yang transport canal from the canal mouth to Guazhou, more than three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: That year they undertook a major dredging of over three hundred li of the Huai-Yang canal from the transport mouth to Guazhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，河督白鍾山言：「衛河水勢，惟在相機啟閉。

translations.literal: In the third year River Director Bai Zhongshan said: "The power of Wei waters lies solely in timely opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: In year three River Superintendent Bai Zhongshan said: "The force of the Wei River depends only on opening and closing according to circumstance.

sentences.zh: 殿最前奏設館陶、臨清二水閘，可不必立。

translations.literal: Dianzui's earlier memorial to establish two water locks at Guantao and Linqing need not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The two water gates at Guantao and Linqing, previously proposed by Zhao Dianzui, need not be established.

sentences.zh: 嗣雨水調勻，百泉各渠閘照舊官民分用。

translations.literal: Subsequently rains were even, and the hundred springs' channels and locks reverted to the old official and civilian division of use.
translations.idiomatic: When rainfall is later balanced, the hundred springs and their channels and locks should, as before, be divided between official and popular use.

sentences.zh: 儻值水淺澀，即暫閉民渠民閘以利漕運。

translations.literal: If water is shallow and sluggish, temporarily close civilian channels and locks to benefit grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: If the water happens to be shallow and sluggish, then temporarily close the people's channels and locks to benefit grain transport.

sentences.zh: 或河水充暢，漕艘早過，官渠官閘亦酌量下板以灌民田。」

translations.literal: Or if river water is full and smooth and grain ships pass early, official channels and locks may also suitably lower boards to irrigate civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: Or if the river water is abundant and the grain boats have passed early, the official channels and official locks may lower boards as appropriate to irrigate the people's fields."

sentences.zh: 是年，修復三教堂減壩，挑濬淤填支河，使泄水入馬頰河。

translations.literal: That year the Santang Church overflow dam was restored, silted branch rivers dredged so water discharged into the Majia River.
translations.idiomatic: That year crews restored the Santang overflow dam and cleared branch channels into the Majia River.

sentences.zh: 又於三空橋舊址修減壩，仍挑通支河，使泄水入徒駭河。

translations.literal: Again at the old site of Sankong Bridge an overflow dam was repaired and the branch river still dredged through so water discharged into the Tuhei River.
translations.idiomatic: They also rebuilt the Sankong Bridge overflow and opened a branch into the Tuhei River.

sentences.zh: 增建裴家口東南涵洞二，修築房家口上下堤岸、馬家閘土堤，及自嶧縣台庄迄臨清板閘運堤八百里纖道，亦資障護瀕河田廬。

translations.literal: Two culverts southeast of Peijiakou were added; dikes above and below Fangjiakou, the earthen dike at Majia Lock, and the eight hundred li towpath on the transport dike from Taizhuang in Yi county to the Linqing board lock were repaired—all also protecting fields and houses along the river.
translations.idiomatic: Work added Peijiakou culverts, Fangjiakou and Majia dikes, and an eight-hundred-li towpath from Taizhuang to Linqing, shielding riverside farms and homes.

sentences.zh: 先是疏濬毛城鋪河道時，高斌以黃流倒灌，移運口於上游七十餘丈，與三汊河接。

translations.literal: Earlier when dredging the Maochengpu river channel, Gao Bin moved the transport mouth upstream more than seventy zhang because the Yellow current flowed back, connecting to the Sancha River.
translations.idiomatic: During Maochengpu dredging, Gao Bin had shifted the canal mouth seventy zhang upstream after Yellow backflow, linking it to Sancha River.

sentences.zh: 次年，黃仍灌運，論者多謂新開運口所致，特命大學士鄂爾泰相度。

translations.literal: The next year the Yellow still inundated transport; many in discussion said it was caused by the newly opened transport mouth; Grand Secretary Ortai was specially ordered to survey.
translations.idiomatic: Next year Yellow water still invaded the canal; critics blamed the new mouth, and Grand Secretary Ortai was ordered to inspect.

sentences.zh: 旋言：「運口直對清口，湖水由裴家場引河東北直趨清口，入運之水仍系迴流平緩；

translations.literal: Soon he said: "The transport mouth directly faces Qingkou; lake water through the Peijia field diversion runs northeast straight toward Qingkou; water entering transport is still eddying flow, level and slow;
translations.idiomatic: He soon said: "The transport mouth faces Qingkou directly; lake water runs northeast from the Peijia Field diversion straight toward Qingkou, while the water entering the canal is still a returning current and gentle.

sentences.zh: 惟新口外挑水壩稍短，清水盛旺，或恐溜寬，宜再築長壩，不必仍舊開口。

translations.literal: only the training dam outside the new mouth is somewhat short; clear water flourishing, one may fear the current widening—it is suitable to build a longer dam, not necessarily reopen the old mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Only the training dam outside the new mouth is somewhat short; when the clear water is abundant, there may be concern that the current will widen, so a long dam should be built further, and the old mouth need not be reopened.

sentences.zh: 惟舊河直捷，新河紆曲，今新建閘壩未開，漕船應行舊河，以利挽運。

translations.literal: Only the old river is direct and quick, the new river winding; now the newly built lock-dam is not open—grain ships should use the old river to benefit towing transport.
translations.idiomatic: But the old channel is direct and the new channel winding; until the newly built locks and dams are opened, grain boats should use the old channel to aid towing.

sentences.zh: 新河於天妃閘下重建通濟、福興二閘，隨時啟閉。

translations.literal: On the new river below Tianfei Lock the Tongji and Fuxing locks were rebuilt, opened and closed as needed.
translations.idiomatic: On the new channel, Tongji and Fuxing locks should be rebuilt below Tianfei Lock and opened or closed according to circumstance.

sentences.zh: 每歲漕船過後，河水充溢，則開放新河以分水勢，湖水漲溢，則閉舊河及新河閘以待水消，庶新舊兩河可以交用。」

translations.literal: Each year after grain ships pass, when river water is full and overflowing, open the new river to divide water power; when lake water rises and overflows, close the old river and new river locks and wait for water to subside—then the old and new rivers may be used in alternation."
translations.idiomatic: Each year after the grain boats have passed, if the river water is full, open the new channel to divide the water's force; if the lake water rises and overflows, close the old channel and the new-channel locks until the water subsides. In this way the new and old channels may be used in alternation."

translations.literal: Thus ended Ortai's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended Ortai's memorial.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰又言：「詳勘漳河故道，一自直隸魏縣北，經山東丘縣城西，至效口村會滏陽河，入大陸澤，下會子牙河，由天津入海。

translations.literal: Ortai further said: "On surveying the Zhang River's old course, one route from north of Wei county in Zhili, passing west of Qiu county city in Shandong, to Xiaokou village meeting the Fuyang River, entering the Dalu Marsh, below joining the Ziya River, by Tianjin entering the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai also said: "A detailed survey of the Zhang River's old courses shows one route from north of Wei county in Zhili, past the west of Qiu county city in Shandong, to Xiaokou village, where it joins the Fuyang River, enters Dalu Marsh, then joins the Ziya River and enters the sea by Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 一由魏縣北老沙河，自潘爾庄經丘縣城東，歷清和、武城、景州、阜城各地，過千頃窪，入運歸海。

translations.literal: One from the old Sha River north of Wei county, from Pan'erzhuang passing east of Qiu county city, through Qinghe, Wucheng, Jingzhou, Fucheng and other places, crossing the Qianqing marsh, entering transport and returning to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Another runs from the old Sha River north of Wei county, from Pan'erzhuang past the east of Qiu county city, through Qinghe, Wucheng, Jingzhou, and Fucheng, across Qianqingwa, and into the canal to return to the sea.

sentences.zh: 丘縣城西故道去衛河較遠，舊跡既淹，開通匪易。

translations.literal: The old course west of Qiu county city is farther from the Wei River; old traces are already submerged—opening it is not easy.
translations.idiomatic: The old course west of Qiu county city is relatively far from the Wei River; its former traces are already submerged, and opening it through would not be easy.

sentences.zh: 且滏陽河下會子牙河，全漳之水亦難容納。

translations.literal: Moreover the Fuyang River below joins the Ziya River; the Zhang's full waters are also hard to contain.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, where the Fuyang River below joins the Ziya River, it would also be difficult to contain all the water of the Zhang.

sentences.zh: 惟老沙河即古馬頰河，河形寬闊，於此挑復故道，自和爾寨村東承漳河北折之勢，開至漳洞村，歸入舊河，勢順工省。

translations.literal: Only the old Sha River is the ancient Majia River; the river form is broad—here restoring the old course, from east of He'erzhai village receiving the Zhang's north-turning momentum, opening to Zhangdong village and returning to the old river, the momentum favorable and labor saved.
translations.idiomatic: Only the old Sha River, which is the ancient Majia River, has a broad channel form. If the old course is dredged and restored there, receiving the Zhang River's northward turn east of He'erzhai village and opening it as far as Zhangdong village to return to the old river, the current will be favorable and the work economical.

sentences.zh: 即於新挑河頭下東流入衛處建閘，如衛水微弱，則啟以濟運，衛水足用，則閉閘使歸故道；

translations.literal: At the head of the newly dredged river where it flows east into the Wei, build a lock; if Wei water is weak, open it to supplement transport; if Wei water suffices, close the lock and let it return to the old course;
translations.idiomatic: At the point where the head of the newly dredged channel flows east into the Wei, build a lock: if Wei water is weak, open it to support transport; if Wei water is sufficient, close the lock and let the water return to its old course.

sentences.zh: 再於青縣下酌建閘壩，臨清以北運道可免淤墊，青縣以下田廬永無浸淹。

translations.literal: Again suitably build lock-dams below Qing county—the transport route north of Linqing can avoid silting, and fields and houses below Qing county will forever be without inundation.
translations.idiomatic: Then build locks and dams as appropriate below Qing county, and the transport route north of Linqing can avoid silting while the fields and houses below Qing county will forever avoid inundation.

sentences.zh: 應飭直、東兩省會勘估修。」

translations.literal: Zhili and Shandong provinces should be ordered to survey jointly and estimate repairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili and Shandong should be ordered to make a joint survey and estimate repairs."

sentences.zh: 五年，改山東管河道為運河道，專司蓄泄疏濬閘壩事，仍管河庫，從白鍾山請也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Shandong canal directorate was renamed the transport canal directorate, specializing in storage, discharge, dredging, and lock-dam affairs, still managing the river treasury—following Bai Zhongshan's request.
translations.idiomatic: In year five Shandong's canal office became a transport-canal bureau under Bai Zhongshan, charged with impoundment, dredging, and locks while keeping the river treasury.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，添建高郵東堤石壩，酌定水則，視水勢大小以為啟閉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year a stone dam was added on Gaoyou's east dike, a water gauge fixed, opening and closing according to the size of the water power.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-two Gaoyou gained an east-bank stone dam with gauges set to open and close with the flood level.

sentences.zh: 巡漕給事中海明言：「江南運河，惟桃源之古城砂礓，溜灘灣沙積，黃河以南，惟揚州之灣頭閘至范公祠三千三百餘丈間段阻淺，均應挑濬。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Censor Hai Ming said: "On the Jiangnan transport canal, only Gucheng's gravel shoal at Taoyuan, swift current and sand accumulation in the bend; south of the Yellow River, only the section from Yangzhou's Wantou Lock to the Fan Gong Shrine—more than three thousand three hundred zhang obstructed and shallow—all should be dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Hai Ming said: "On the Jiangnan canal, Taoyuan's Gucheng gravel and Liutan Bay sand deposits, and south of the Yellow River the more than three-thousand-zhang shallow stretch from Yangzhou's Wantou Lock to the Fan Shrine, should all be dredged.

sentences.zh: 鎮江至丹徒、常州，水本無源，恃江潮灌注，冬春潮小則淺。

translations.literal: From Zhenjiang to Dantu and Changzhou, water originally has no source and relies on Yangzi tidal infusion; in winter and spring when tides are small it is shallow.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhenjiang to Dantu and Changzhou, the water has no source and depends on Yangzi tides; when winter and spring tides are small, it becomes shallow.

sentences.zh: 加以每日潮汐易淤，兩岸土松易卸，應六年大挑一次，否則三年亦須擇段撈淺。

translations.literal: Added to this, daily tides easily silt and both banks' soil is loose and easily sloughs off—there should be a major dredging every six years; otherwise every three years sections must be chosen for shallow dredging.
translations.idiomatic: In addition, daily tides easily create silt, and the loose soil on both banks easily collapses. A major dredging should be done once every six years; otherwise shallow sections must be selected and cleared every three years.

sentences.zh: 丹徒兩閘以下，常州之武進等縣，亦間段淺滯，均應一律挑濬。」

translations.literal: Below the two locks of Dantu, in Changzhou's Wujin and other counties, there are also intermittent shallow obstructions—all should be dredged uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: Below the two Dantu locks and in Wujin and other counties of Changzhou, there are also shallow and sluggish sections, all of which should be dredged uniformly."

sentences.zh: 詔：「挑河易滋浮冒，宜往來查察，毋得屬之委員。」

translations.literal: The edict said: "Dredging rivers easily breeds inflated claims; superiors should inspect back and forth and must not delegate to subordinates."
translations.idiomatic: The edict said: "Dredging rivers easily breeds false claims and inflated charges. Officials should inspect back and forth and must not entrust the work to deputies."

translations.literal: Thus ended the imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，命海明及河督張師載、東撫阿爾泰會勘直、東運河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Hai Ming and River Director Zhang Shizai and Shandong Governor Aertai were ordered to survey jointly the Zhili and Shandong transport canals.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-four Hai Ming, Zhang Shizai, and Governor Aertai were commissioned to inspect the Zhili and Shandong canals together.

sentences.zh: 初，運河水漲，漫溢德州等處，景州一帶道路淤阻。

translations.literal: Earlier transport canal water rose and overflowed at Dezhou and other places; the Jingzhou stretch of roads was silt-blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Canal floods had earlier inundated Dezhou and silted roads around Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 至是，海明等言：「漳、衛二河，伏秋盛漲，宜旁加疏泄。

translations.literal: By this time Hai Ming and others said: "The Zhang and Wei two rivers, at the height of summer flood, should have added lateral discharge.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Hai Ming and the others said: "During the summer and autumn rises, the Zhang and Wei rivers should be given additional side drainage.

sentences.zh: 自臨清至恩縣四女寺二百五十餘里，河身盤曲，臨清塔灣東岸原有沙河一，即黃河遺迹，由清平、德州、高唐入馬頰河歸海。

translations.literal: From Linqing to En county's Sinv Temple, more than two hundred fifty li—the river body winding; on the east bank of Linqing's Tawan there was originally one Sha River, a Yellow River trace, through Qingping, Dezhou, and Gaotang entering the Majia River and returning to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: From Linqing to Sinv Temple in En County, more than two hundred fifty li, the river channel twists and turns; on the east bank at Tawan in Linqing there was originally a Sha River, a trace of the Yellow River, which went from Qingping through Dezhou and Gaotang into the Majia River and back to the sea.

sentences.zh: 請開挑作滾水石壩，使汶、衛合流，分泄水勢。

translations.literal: It is requested to dredge and open it as a rolling stone dam so Wen and Wei unite in flow and divide water power.
translations.idiomatic: Please dredge it and make it a rolling stone dam, so the Wen and Wei can join their flows and divide the water's force.

sentences.zh: 四女寺、哨馬營兩支河，原系旁泄汶、衛歸海之路，請將狹處展寬，以免下游德州等處沖溢。」

translations.literal: The two branch rivers at Sinv Temple and Shaomaying were originally side routes for Wen and Wei to return to the sea; it is requested to widen the narrow places so downstream Dezhou and other places are not struck and overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: The two branch rivers at Sinv Temple and Shaomaying were originally routes by which the Wen and Wei drained sideways and returned to the sea. Please widen the narrow places to prevent Dezhou and other downstream places from being rushed and flooded."

sentences.zh: 二十五年，巡漕給事中耀海偕師載言：「南旺以北僅馬踏一湖，水患不足。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Grain Transport Censor Yao Hai together with Shizai said: "North of Nanwang there is only Mata Lake—insufficient for water calamities.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-five Censor Yao Hai and Shizai said: "North of Nanwang there is only Mata Lake, so the floodwater is insufficiently controlled.

sentences.zh: 獨山湖有金線閘，水祗南流，利濟閘水可北注。

translations.literal: Dushan Lake has the Jinxian Lock; water only flows south; Liji Lock water can pour north.
translations.idiomatic: Dushan Lake has Jinxian Lock, whose water flows only south, while the water of Liji Lock can pour north.

sentences.zh: 請移金線閘於柳林閘北，使獨山諸湖全注北運河。」

translations.literal: It is requested to move the Jinxian Lock north of Liulin Lock so all Dushan lakes fully pour into the north transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: Please move Jinxian Lock north of Liulin Lock, so the Dushan lakes all pour into the northern canal."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: Imperial approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，以魚台辛庄橋北舊有泄水口二，口門刷深，難以節制，允師載等請改建滾壩一。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, because north of Xinzhuang Bridge in Yutai there were formerly two discharge mouths whose openings had been scoured deep and were hard to regulate, Shizai and others' request to rebuild one rolling dam was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-seven two scoured outlets north of Yutai's Xinzhuang Bridge, impossible to control, were replaced with a rolling dam as Shizai proposed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，挑德州西方菴對岸引河，自魏家莊至新河頭，長四十丈，建築齊家莊挑溜埽壩，接築清口東西壩，修李家務石閘。

translations.literal: That year the diversion river opposite Xifang'an in Dezhou was dredged, from Weijiazhuang to Xinhetou, forty zhang long; the Qijiazhuang training revetment dam was built, the Qingkou east and west dams continued, and the Lijiawu stone lock was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: That year crews dredged a forty-zhang diversion at Dezhou's Xifang'an, built Qijiazhuang training works, extended Qingkou's east-west dams, and repaired Lijiawu stone lock.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，用阿爾泰言，於臨清運河逼近村莊處開引河五，以分水勢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, following Aertai's words, five diversion rivers were opened where the Linqing transport canal approached villages, to divide water power.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-eight, on Aertai's advice, five cuts were opened where the Linqing canal hugged villages to split the current.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，黃水入運，命大學士劉統勛等往開臨黃壩，以泄盛漲，並疏濬運河淤淺。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year Yellow water entered transport; Grand Secretary Liu Tongxun and others were sent to open the Linhuang dam to discharge the great flood, and also dredge transport canal silt and shallows.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-three, with Yellow water in the canal, Liu Tongxun's party opened the Linhuang dam and dredged shoals along the route.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，河督姚立德言：「泗河下流董家口向建石壩分泄，今泗水南趨，轉為石壩所累。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year River Director Yao Lide said: "On the Si River's lower reach at Dongjiakou a stone dam was formerly built to divide discharge; now Si water trends south and is instead obstructed by the stone dam.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-seven River Superintendent Yao Lide said: "At Dongjiakou on the lower Si River, a stone dam had formerly been built to divide and release the flow; now the Si water turns south and is instead hampered by the stone dam.

sentences.zh: 請拆去，並展寬孟家橋舊石橋。」

translations.literal: It is requested to demolish it and also widen the old stone bridge at Mengjia Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Please remove it and also widen the old stone bridge at Mengjia Bridge."

sentences.zh: 如所請行。

translations.literal: It was carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved as petitioned.

sentences.zh: 五十年，命大學士阿桂履勘河工。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year Grand Secretary Agui was ordered to inspect river works on site.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty Grand Secretary Agui was sent to survey the river works in person.

sentences.zh: 阿桂言：「臣初到此間，詢商薩載、李奉翰及河上員弁，多主引黃灌湖之說。

translations.literal: Agui said: "When I first arrived here I consulted Shang Saizai, Li Fenghan, and river officers and soldiers; many upheld the theory of drawing Yellow to fill lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Agui said: "When I first arrived here, I consulted Shang Saizai, Li Fenghan, and the officers on the river, and most supported the proposal to draw Yellow River water into the lakes.

sentences.zh: 本年湖水極小，不但黃絕清弱，至六月以後，竟至清水涓滴無出，又值黃水盛漲，倒灌入運，直達淮、揚。

translations.literal: This year lake water was extremely small—not only was Yellow absolutely weak and clear weak, but after the sixth month clear water ceased to drip out at all; again it coincided with Yellow water in great flood, flowing back into transport, reaching straight to Huai and Yang.
translations.idiomatic: This year the lake water is extremely low. Not only is Yellow River water cut off and clear water weak; after the sixth month, not a drop of clear water came out. It also happened that Yellow River water was in great flood and backed into the canal, reaching Huai and Yang.

sentences.zh: 計惟有借已灌之黃水以送回空，蓄積弱之清水以濟重運。

translations.literal: The plan is only to borrow already-irrigated Yellow water to send back the empty fleet, store up weak clear water to supplement the heavy-laden transport.
translations.idiomatic: The only plan is to use the Yellow River water already brought in to send back the empty boats and to store the weakened clear water to support the loaded transport.

sentences.zh: 查本年二進糧艘行入淮河，全藉黃水浮送，方能過淮渡黃，則回空時雖值黃水消落，而空船吃水無多，設法調劑，似可銜尾遄行。」

translations.literal: Investigation shows this year's second grain fleet entering the Huai River entirely relied on Yellow water to float and send them, only then able to cross Huai and pass Yellow; then on the return, though Yellow water subsides, empty ships draw little water—with devised adjustment, it seems they can follow tail to tail in swift passage.
translations.idiomatic: Looking at this year's second-entry grain boats, they entered the Huai River entirely by relying on Yellow River water to float them and only thus could cross the Huai and pass the Yellow River. When the boats return empty, although the Yellow River water will be falling, empty boats draw little water; with suitable management, they should be able to proceed one after another quickly."

sentences.zh: 借黃濟運，自此始也。

translations.literal: Borrowing Yellow to supplement transport began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Using Yellow River water for the grain transport began here.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，運河盛漲，致淮安迤下東岸涇河泄水石閘牆蟄底翻，難資啟閉。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year the transport canal swelled greatly, causing the Jing River discharge stone lock on the east bank below Huai'an—its wall tide-eaten and base overturned—unable to serve for opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-one a canal flood wrecked Huai'an's Jing River stone sluice on the east bank, its walls undermined so the gates would not work.

sentences.zh: 越五年，山陽、寶應士民修復之。

translations.literal: Five years later the gentry and people of Shanyang and Baoying restored it.
translations.idiomatic: Five years on, local gentry in Shanyang and Baoying rebuilt it.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，河決豐汛，刷開南運河佘家莊堤，由豐、沛北注金鄉、魚台，漾入微山、昭陽各湖，穿入運河，漫溢兩岸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing the river burst in the Feng flood season, scouring open the Shejiazhuang dike on the South Transport Canal; from Feng and Pei it poured north into Jinxiang and Yutai, spreading into Weishan, Zhaoyang, and other lakes, piercing into the transport canal and overflowing both banks.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing year one a summer breach at Feng scoured through the South Canal dike at Shejiazhuang, flooding north through Feng and Pei into the lakes and back into the canal.

sentences.zh: 是冬，漫口塞，凌汛復蟄陷。

translations.literal: That winter the breach mouth was closed; in the ice flood season it again was tide-eaten and collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The gap closed that winter but failed again in the spring ice run.

sentences.zh: 次年，東西兩壩並蟄，二月工始竣。

translations.literal: The next year both east and west dams were tide-eaten; work was not finished until the second month.
translations.idiomatic: The following year both east and west dams gave way; repairs lasted until the second month.

sentences.zh: 自豐工決後，若曹工、睢工、衡工，幾於無歲不決。

translations.literal: After the Feng works breach, at Cao works, Sui works, and Heng works, there were nearly no years without breaches.
translations.idiomatic: After Feng, breaches at Cao, Sui, and Heng became almost annual.

sentences.zh: 九年，因山東運河淺塞，大加濬治；

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because the Shandong transport canal was shallow and blocked, it received major dredging;
translations.idiomatic: In year nine the silt-choked Shandong canal was heavily dredged;

sentences.zh: 又預蓄微山諸湖水為利運資。

translations.literal: again Weishan and other lake waters were stored in advance as resources to benefit transport.
translations.idiomatic: and Weishan's lakes were impounded early to feed the route.

sentences.zh: 然自是以後，黃高於清，漕艘轉資黃水浮送，淤沙日積，利一而害百矣。

translations.literal: Yet from this time onward Yellow was higher than clear; grain ships increasingly relied on Yellow water to float and send them; silt daily accumulated—one benefit and a hundred harms.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Yellow stood above the clear channel; the fleet depended on muddy water while silt piled up—gaining little at enormous cost.

sentences.zh: 十二年，倉場侍郎德文等請挑修張家灣正河，堵築康家溝以復運道，御史賈允升請挑濬減河，均下直督溫承惠勘辦。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Granary Director Dewen and others requested dredging the main river at Zhangjiawan and blocking Kangjiagou to restore the transport route; Censor Jia Yunsheng requested dredging the overflow river—all referred to Zhili Governor Wen Chenghui for survey and handling.
translations.idiomatic: In year twelve Dewen sought to reopen Zhangjiawan's main channel and seal Kangjiagou; Censor Jia Yunsheng wanted the relief river dredged—both sent to Governor Wen Chenghui.

sentences.zh: 承惠請濬溫榆河上游。

translations.literal: Chenghui requested dredging the upper reach of the Wenyu River.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghui proposed dredging the Wenyu upstream.

sentences.zh: 上命侍郎托津、英和偕德文等覆勘。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Vice Minister Tuojin and Yinghe together with Dewen and others to survey again.
translations.idiomatic: The throne sent Tuojin, Yinghe, and Dewen to reinspect.

sentences.zh: 尋奏言：「頻年漕運皆藉溫榆下游倒漾之水，以致泥沙淤積。

translations.literal: Soon they memorialized: "In successive years grain transport has all relied on the Wenyu's lower reach back-surging water, causing mud and sand to silt up.
translations.idiomatic: They soon memorialized: "For several years grain transport has relied on backflow from the lower Wenyu, causing mud and sand to accumulate.

sentences.zh: 若從上游深挑，直抵石壩，實為因勢利導。

translations.literal: If from the upper reach it is deeply dredged straight to the stone dam, it truly follows the terrain's advantage.
translations.idiomatic: If dredging is carried deeply from upstream straight to the stone dam, it will truly guide the current according to its force.

sentences.zh: 惟地勢高下，須逐細測量，俾全河毫無滯礙方善。」

translations.literal: Only the terrain's high and low must be measured inch by inch so the whole river has not the slightest obstruction—then it is good.
translations.idiomatic: Only the rise and fall of the terrain must be measured carefully section by section, so that the whole river has no obstruction at all."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: Imperial approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 十三年，通州大水，康家溝壩衝決成河，張家灣河道遂淤。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Tongzhou suffered great flood; the Kangjiagou dam was breached and became a river, and the Zhangjiawan river channel was then silted.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirteen a Tongzhou flood broke Kangjiagou into a new river and silted Zhangjiawan's channel.

sentences.zh: 倉場侍郎達慶請來年糧艘由康家溝試行一年，暫緩挑復張家灣河身。

translations.literal: Granary Director Daqing requested that next year's grain ships trial the route through Kangjiagou for one year and temporarily defer dredging Zhangjiawan's river body.
translations.idiomatic: Director Daqing asked to route next year's fleet through Kangjiagou for a trial year and postpone restoring Zhangjiawan.

sentences.zh: 上命尚書吳璥往勘，與達慶議合，遂允之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Minister Wu Jin to go survey; it accorded with Daqing's deliberation, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Wu Jin inspected, agreed with Daqing, and the trial was allowed.

sentences.zh: 明年，御史史祜言，康家溝河道難行，請復張家灣正河。

translations.literal: The next year Censor Shi Hu said the Kangjiagou river route was hard to navigate and requested restoring Zhangjiawan's main river.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Censor Shi Hu declared Kangjiagou unworkable and urged reopening Zhangjiawan's main channel.

sentences.zh: 下直督溫承惠。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to Zhili Governor Wen Chenghui.
translations.idiomatic: The case went to Governor Wen Chenghui of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 承惠言：「康家溝溜勢奔騰，漕船逆流而上，大費纖輓。

translations.literal: Chenghui reported: "At Kangjiagou the current's momentum rushes and surges; grain ships go upstream against the current, greatly expending tracking and towing.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Chenghui said: "At Kangjiagou the current runs fiercely, and grain boats going upstream spend enormous effort on trackers and towlines.

sentences.zh: 該處地勢正高，恐旱乾之歲，河水一瀉無餘，漕行更為棘手。

translations.literal: That place's terrain is precisely high; one fears that in dry years the river water will pour out in one rush without remainder, and grain transport will be still more difficult to handle.
translations.idiomatic: The terrain there is precisely high, and I fear that in dry years the river water will drain away entirely, making passage for grain boats still more difficult.

sentences.zh: 惟張家灣兩岸沙灘，壩基難立，而正河積淤日久，挑濬亦甚不易。」

translations.literal: Only at Zhangjiawan both banks are sandy beaches, a dam foundation is hard to establish, and the main river has accumulated silt over a long time; dredging is also very difficult."
translations.idiomatic: But on both banks at Zhangjiawan are sandy shoals, so dam foundations are hard to establish, and the main river has been silted up for a long time, so dredging it is also very difficult."

sentences.zh: 上復遣工部尚書戴均元往勘，亦言壩基難立，且時日已迫，恐河道未復，漕運已來，請仍由康家溝行，再察看一年酌定。

translations.literal: The emperor again sent Works Minister Dai Junyuan to survey; he too said a dam foundation was hard to establish, and the days were already pressing; he feared the river channel would not be restored before grain transport arrived, and requested still routing through Kangjiagou, then observing one more year and deciding as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The throne sent Works Minister Dai Junyuan to inspect; he agreed that no dam could be founded in time and that the fleet might arrive before the old channel reopened, so he urged keeping Kangjiagou for another year while watching conditions.

sentences.zh: 如所請行。

translations.literal: It was carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved his request.

sentences.zh: 時淮、揚運河三百餘里淺阻，兩淮鹽政阿克當阿請俟九月內漕船過竣，堵閉清江三壩，築壩斷流，自清江至瓜洲分段挑濬。

translations.literal: At that time the Huai-Yang Grand Canal for more than three hundred li was shallow and obstructed; Lianghuai Salt Controller Akedang'a requested waiting until the grain ships within September had all passed, then blocking and closing Qingjiang's three dams, building dams to cut off flow, and dredging in sections from Qingjiang to Guazhou.
translations.idiomatic: With over three hundred li of the Huai-Yang canal shoaled shut, Salt Controller Akedang'a asked to wait until September's grain convoy had cleared, then seal Qingjiang's three dams, cut the flow, and dredge section by section down to Guazhou.

sentences.zh: 下部議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to the ministries for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal went to the ministries for review.

sentences.zh: 覆稱：「近年運河淺阻，固由疊次漫口，而漫口之故，則由黃水倒灌，倒灌之故，則由河底墊高，清水頂阻，不能不借黃濟運，以致積淤潰決，百病叢生。

translations.literal: The reply stated: "In recent years the Grand Canal's shallowness and obstruction, though indeed owing to repeated overflow breaches, the cause of overflow breaches is Yellow River water backing in; the cause of backing in is the river bottom being raised and padded high, clear water blocked and resisted, so one cannot but borrow Yellow River water to aid transport, leading to accumulated silt, breach and collapse, and a hundred ailments arising together.
translations.idiomatic: The reply said: "Recent shallowing and obstruction in the canal certainly come from repeated overflow mouths; the overflow mouths come from Yellow River backflow; the backflow comes from the raised riverbed and blocked clear water, which makes it necessary to borrow the Yellow River to support transport, producing silt buildup, breaches, and every kind of trouble.

sentences.zh: 是運河為受病之地，而非致病之原。

translations.literal: Thus the Grand Canal is the place that receives the disease, not the source that causes the disease.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the canal is the place suffering the illness, not the source that caused the illness.

sentences.zh: 果使清得暢出敵黃，並分流濟運，則運口內新淤不得停留，舊淤並可刷滌。

translations.literal: If clear water could truly flow out freely to oppose the Yellow River, and also be divided off to aid transport, then new silt within the transport mouth could not remain, and old silt could also be scoured and washed away.
translations.idiomatic: If clear water can flow out freely to resist the Yellow River and also divide its flow to support transport, then new silt inside the transport mouth will not remain, and old silt can be scoured away.

sentences.zh: 若不除倒灌之根，而亟亟以挑濬運河為事，恐旋挑旋淤，運河之挑濬愈深，倒灌之勢愈猛，決堤吸溜，為患滋多。」

translations.literal: If one does not remove the root of backflow but urgently makes dredging the Grand Canal the main task, one fears dredge and immediately silt again; the deeper the Grand Canal is dredged, the fiercer the backflow's momentum, with dike breach and suction eddies, and harms growing ever more."
translations.idiomatic: If the root of the backflow is not removed and people rush to make dredging the canal the main task, I fear it will silt up as soon as it is dredged; the deeper the canal is dredged, the fiercer the backflow will become, and breached dikes and sucking currents will create still more harm."

sentences.zh: 命尚書托津等偕河督勘辦。

translations.literal: The order went to Minister Tuojin and others to join the River Director in surveying and handling the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Tuojin and colleagues were ordered to inspect the works with the river governor.

sentences.zh: 十八年，漕督阮元以邳、宿運河閘少，水淺沙停，請於匯澤閘上下添建二閘。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Grain Transport Director Ruan Yuan, because the Pi-Su Grand Canal had few locks, shallow water, and sand settling, requested adding two locks above and below Huize Lock.
translations.idiomatic: In year eighteen Director Ruan Yuan, finding the Pi-Su canal short of locks and choked with shallow sand, asked for two new locks above and below Huize.

sentences.zh: 下江督百齡核奏。

translations.literal: It was sent to Lower Yangtze Governor Baoling for verification and memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Baoling of the lower Yangtze was told to review and report.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，山東河湖山水並發，戴村壩迤北堤埝漫決六十餘丈，草工刷三十餘丈，四女寺支河南岸汶水旁泄處三。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Daoguang reign, Shandong's rivers and lakes saw mountain floods break out together; north of Daicun Dam along the dike embankment overflow breached for more than sixty zhang, sod work was scoured away for more than thirty zhang, and on the south bank of the Sinvsi branch three places where Wen River water leaked aside.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang year one brought concurrent mountain floods in Shandong: north of Daicun Dam the levee breached over sixty zhang, thirty more of fascine work washed away, and three leaks opened on the Sinvsi branch where Wen River water escaped.

sentences.zh: 用巡撫姚祖同言，於正河旁舊河形內抽溝導水濟運，兼顧湖瀦。

translations.literal: Following Governor Yao Zutong's words, within the old river form beside the main river a ditch was cut to lead water to aid transport, while also attending to lake impoundment.
translations.idiomatic: On Governor Yao Zutong's advice they cut a channel in the old riverbed beside the main stream to feed transport and refill the lakes.

sentences.zh: 三年，漫直隸王家莊，由各廳汛賠修。

translations.literal: In the third year there was overflow at Wangjiazhuang in Zhili; each bureau and flood post paid for repairs.
translations.idiomatic: Year three saw a breach at Wangjiazhuang in Zhili, repaired at the expense of the local river offices.

sentences.zh: 是歲添築戴村壩北官堤碎石壩四。

translations.literal: That year four stone-block dams on the official dike north of Daicun Dam were added and built.
translations.idiomatic: That same year four stone revetment dams were added on the official levee north of Daicun.

sentences.zh: 四年，侍講學士潘錫恩陳借黃濟運之弊，略言：「蓄清敵黃，為相傳成法。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Lecturing Academician Pan Xien memorialized the harms of borrowing Yellow River water to aid transport, stating in brief: "Storing clear water to oppose the Yellow River is the transmitted established method.
translations.idiomatic: Year four Lecturer Pan Xien set out the evils of using Yellow River water for transport, saying in outline: "Storing clear water to resist the Yellow River is the established method handed down from the past.

sentences.zh: 今年張文浩遲堵御黃壩，致倒灌停淤，釀成巨患。

translations.literal: This year Zhang Wenhao was slow in blocking the Yellow River control dam, causing backflow and stagnant silt and brewing a great calamity.
translations.idiomatic: This year Zhang Wenhao was late in closing the Yellow River control dam, causing backflow to settle into silt and brew a great disaster.

sentences.zh: 若更引黃入運，河道淤滿，處處壅溢，恐有決口之患。」

translations.literal: If Yellow River water is further led into the transport canal, the river channel will silt full, everywhere choked and overflowing, and one fears the harm of breach openings."
translations.idiomatic: If Yellow River water is further drawn into the canal, the river channels will fill with silt and overflow everywhere, and I fear there will be breaches."

sentences.zh: 下尚書文孚等妥議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to Ministers Wen Fu and others for proper deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers Wen Fu and colleagues were ordered to deliberate the proposal.

sentences.zh: 自嘉慶之季，黃河屢決，致運河淤墊日甚，而歷年借黃濟運，議者亦知非計，於是有籌及海運者。

translations.literal: From the late Jiaqing period the Yellow River repeatedly breached, causing the Grand Canal's silt padding to grow daily worse, yet year after year Yellow River water was borrowed to aid transport; deliberators also knew this was no proper plan, and so there arose those who planned for sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: Since late Jiaqing the Yellow River had broken repeatedly, silting the Grand Canal ever higher, while year after year muddy water was used to float grain—a policy critics knew was unsound, which is why some began to urge sea transport.

sentences.zh: 五年，上因漕督魏元煜等籌議海運，群以窒礙難行，獨大學士英和有通籌漕、河全局，暫雇海船以分滯運，酌折漕額以資治河之議，下所司及督撫悉心籌畫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because Grain Transport Director Wei Yuanyu and others deliberated sea transport, the emperor found the group saying obstacles made it hard to carry out; only Grand Secretary Yinghe had a plan to coordinate the whole of grain transport and rivers, temporarily hiring sea ships to share the backlog transport, and weighing a reduction of grain quotas to fund river control—the matter was sent to the responsible offices and governors-general and governors to deliberate with full care.
translations.idiomatic: Year five, as Director Wei Yuanyu and others studied sea transport, most officials called it impractical; only Grand Secretary Yinghe proposed a coordinated river-and-canal plan to charter seagoing ships for part of the backlog and trim grain quotas to pay for river works, and the throne told every yamen and province to work out details.

sentences.zh: 卒以黃、運兩河受病已深，非旦夕所能疏治，詔於明年暫行海運一次。

translations.literal: In the end, because the Yellow River and transport river had both been diseased to a deep degree and could not be dredged and cured in a morning and evening, an edict ordered that the next year sea transport be temporarily carried out once.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing both rivers too far gone for quick repair, the court decreed a one-year trial of sea transport the following year.

sentences.zh: 新授兩江總督琦善言：「臣抵清江，即赴運河及濟運、束清各壩逐加履勘。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Governor-General of the Two Jiangs Qishan said: "Your servant reached Qingjiang and at once went to the Grand Canal and the transport-aiding and clear-water-restraining dams, adding step-by-step on-site surveys.
translations.idiomatic: The new Governor-General of the Two Jiangs, Qishan, reported: "On reaching Qingjiang I immediately walked the canal and inspected every dam on the transport and clear-water lines.

sentences.zh: 自借黃濟運以來，運河底高一丈數尺，兩灘積淤寬厚，中泓如線。

translations.literal: Since borrowing Yellow River water to aid transport, the Grand Canal bottom has risen one zhang and several chi; both banks have accumulated silt wide and thick, and the central channel is like a thread.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yellow River water had been used for transport, the canal bed had risen more than a zhang, both banks were heaped with silt, and the fairway had shrunk to a thread.

sentences.zh: 向來河面寬三四十丈者，今只寬十丈至五六丈不等，河底深丈五六尺者，今只存水三四尺，並有深不及五寸者。

translations.literal: Where formerly the river surface was thirty or forty zhang wide, now it is only ten zhang to five or six zhang, unequal; where the river bottom was one zhang five or six chi deep, now only three or four chi of water remain, and there are places less than five cun deep.
translations.idiomatic: Reaches once thirty or forty zhang across now measured ten down to five or six; depths that had been a zhang and a half held only three or four chi of water, and some spots barely five cun.

sentences.zh: 舟只在在膠淺，進退俱難。

translations.literal: Boats everywhere are stuck in shallow mud; advancing and retreating are both difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels grounded everywhere; they could neither advance nor withdraw.

sentences.zh: 濟運壩所蓄湖水雖漸滋長，水頭下注不過三寸，未能暢注。

translations.literal: Although the lake water stored at the transport-aiding dam gradually increased, the water head flowing down was no more than three cun and could not pour in freely.
translations.idiomatic: Lake water behind the transport dam was rising, yet the head feeding downstream barely three cun and could not run freely.

sentences.zh: 淮安三十餘里皆然，高、寶以上之運河全賴湖水，其情大可想見。

translations.literal: For more than thirty li around Huai'an it was all thus; the Grand Canal above Gaoyou and Baoying wholly relies on lake water—the situation can largely be imagined.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty li around Huai'an were the same, and the canal above Gaoyou and Baoying depended entirely on lake water—one could guess the rest.

sentences.zh: 請飭河、漕二臣將河面淤墊處展挑寬深，再放湖水，藉資輓送，以期不誤北上期限。」

translations.literal: I request ordering the two officials of river and grain transport to dredge the silt-padded places on the river surface wider and deeper, then release lake water again to borrow strength for towing, in hope of not missing the northbound deadline."
translations.idiomatic: He asked the river and grain directors to widen and deepen the shoals, then release lake water to help towing so the northbound fleet would not miss its schedule."

sentences.zh: 上以「借黃濟運，原系權宜辦理，孫玉庭察看漕艘挽運艱難，不早陳奏變計，魏元煜舊任漕督，及與顏檢坐觀事機敗壞，隱忍不言，糜帑病民，是誠何心？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Borrowing Yellow River water to aid transport was originally a temporary expedient. Sun Yuting inspected grain ships' towing hardships yet did not early memorialize to change the plan; Wei Yuanyu formerly served as grain transport director, and together with Yan Jian sat watching as affairs deteriorated, concealing and not speaking, wasting treasury funds and harming the people—what truly is in their hearts?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Using Yellow River water to support transport was originally a temporary expedient. Sun Yuting saw the hardship of towing grain boats and did not memorialize early to change the plan; Wei Yuanyu formerly served as grain transport director, and he and Yan Jian sat watching as affairs deteriorated, bearing it in silence without speaking, wasting public funds and harming the people. What was truly in their minds?

sentences.zh: 令將運河淤墊一律挑深，費由玉庭、元煜、檢分賠。」

translations.literal: He ordered that the Grand Canal's silt padding be dredged deep throughout, with costs divided for compensation among Yuting, Yuanyu, and Jian."
translations.idiomatic: Order the canal's silted places all dredged deep, with the cost divided among Yuting, Yuanyu, and Jian for repayment."

sentences.zh: 琦善又言，自御黃壩堵閉，運河淤墊不復增高，而洪湖清水蓄至丈餘，各船可資浮送，不敢冒昧挑濬。

translations.literal: Qishan further said that since the Yellow River control dam was blocked and closed, the Grand Canal's silt padding no longer rose higher, while clear water in Hong Lake was stored to more than a zhang, so each ship could rely on floating transport; he dared not rashly dredge.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan added that once the Yellow River dam was sealed the canal bed had stopped rising, Hong Lake held over a zhang of clear water adequate to float the fleet, and he hesitated to dredge recklessly.

sentences.zh: 工費至省在百萬外，玉庭等罄其所有，斷無如許家資。

translations.literal: Project costs, even at the most economical, exceed one million; Yuting and the others could exhaust all they own and still absolutely lack such household wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Even a minimal estimate topped a million taels—far beyond anything Sun Yuting and the others could pay from their estates.

sentences.zh: 更可慮者，欲濬運河，必先堵束清壩，阻絕來源，而後可以涸底挑辦。

translations.literal: Still more to be feared: to dredge the Grand Canal one must first block the clear-water-restraining dam, cutting off the source, and only then can the bottom be dried for dredging work.
translations.idiomatic: Worse, dredging required first sealing the clear-water dam to cut the supply and dry the bed—only then could digging proceed.

sentences.zh: 現湖水下注湍急，束清壩外跌塘甚深，又系清水，不能掛淤閉氣。

translations.literal: At present lake water pours down swiftly; outside the clear-water-restraining dam the plunge pool is very deep, and it is clear water that cannot hang silt and seal air.
translations.idiomatic: Lake water now poured down fiercely; below the clear-water dam the plunge pool ran deep with clear water that would not hold mud or seal properly.

sentences.zh: 設正事興挑，而束清壩臌開，則工廢半途，費歸虛擲。

translations.literal: If the main work is started and dredging begun, yet the clear-water-restraining dam bulges and opens, then the work is abandoned halfway and the expense returns to being thrown away in vain.
translations.idiomatic: If dredging began and the clear-water dam burst, the project would halt halfway and every expense would be wasted.

sentences.zh: 請停止里、揚運河挑工，以免草率而節糜費。」

translations.literal: I request stopping dredging work on the Li-Yang Grand Canal section, to avoid haste and save wasted expenditure."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to halt dredging on the Li-Yang canal to avoid slipshod work and needless cost.

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 是年，築溫榆河上游果渠村壩埽。

translations.literal: That year, at Guoqu Village upstream on the Wenyu River, dam revetment was built.
translations.idiomatic: That year revetment works went up at Guoqu Village on the upper Wenyu River.

sentences.zh: 七年，東河總督張井、副總河潘錫恩請修復北運河劉老澗石滾壩、中河廳南纖堤、揚糧二廳東西纖堤及堤外石工，移建昭關壩。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Eastern River Governor-General Zhang Jing and Vice River Director Pan Xien requested restoring the stone roller dam at Liulaojian on the Northern Grand Canal, the south tracking dike of the Central River Bureau, the east and west tracking dikes of the Yang Grain Two Bureaus and stone work outside the dike, and relocating and building Zhaoguan Dam.
translations.idiomatic: Year seven Governors Zhang Jing and Pan Xien sought to restore the Liulaojian roller dam on the northern canal, tracking dikes south of the central river office and east and west of the Yang grain offices, outer stone revetments, and to move Zhaoguan Dam.

sentences.zh: 上遣英和等馳勘，乃定移昭關壩於其北三元宮之南，餘如所請行。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Yinghe and others on urgent survey; it was then decided to move Zhaoguan Dam to the south of Sanyuan Palace north of its former site; the rest was carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghe was sent to inspect quickly; Zhaoguan Dam was fixed south of Sanyuan Palace, and the other repairs proceeded as proposed.

sentences.zh: 十一年，高郵湖河漫馬棚灣及十四堡，湖河連為一。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Gaoyou Lake and river overflowed at Mapeng Bay and Fourteen Forts; lake and river joined as one.
translations.idiomatic: Year eleven floodwater at Mapeng Bay and Fourteen Forts merged Gaoyou Lake with the canal into one sheet of water.

sentences.zh: 江督陶澍請依嘉慶間故事，運河決口，重空糧艘均繞湖行。

translations.literal: Jiangsu Governor Tao Shu requested following the Jiaqing precedent: when the Grand Canal breached, heavy and empty grain ships alike all routed around the lake.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Tao Shu asked, as in Jiaqing times, to route loaded and empty grain ships around the lake when the canal broke.

sentences.zh: 八月，十四堡塞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Fourteen Forts was closed up.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the breach at Fourteen Forts was sealed.

sentences.zh: 冬，馬棚灣塞。

translations.literal: In winter Mapeng Bay was closed up.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Mapeng Bay was closed as well.

sentences.zh: 先是澍撫蘇時，以鎮江運河並無水源，祗恃江潮浮送，下練湖湮塞已久，移建黃泥閘於張官渡以當湖之下流，俾得擎托湖流，使之回漾，稍濟江潮之不逮，曾著成效。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Tao Shu governed Jiangsu, because the Zhenjiang Grand Canal had no water source and relied only on Yangtze tides for floating transport, Lower Lian Lake had long been silted shut; he moved and built Huangni Lock at Zhanggu Ferry to stand at the lake's lower reach, so as to lift and support lake flow, make it swirl back, and slightly remedy where Yangtze tides fell short—once achieving marked effect.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier as Jiangsu governor Tao Shu had found the Zhenjiang canal sourceless and dependent on Yangtze tides; with Lower Lian Lake long choked, he moved Huangni Lock to Zhanggu Ferry to catch lake outflow, turn it back upstream, and supplement the tides—a scheme that had worked well.

sentences.zh: 至十四年遷江督，復偕巡撫林則徐相度，於湖頂沖之黃金壩及東岡築兩重蓄水壩，培圩埂二千八百八十丈，使水得入湖。

translations.literal: By the fourteenth year, transferred to Jiangsu governor, he again joined Governor Lin Zexu in surveying; at Huangjin Dam on the lake crest's impact point and at East Mound they built two tiers of water-storage dams, raised dike ridges for two thousand eight hundred eighty zhang, so water could enter the lake.
translations.idiomatic: After becoming Jiangsu governor in year fourteen he and Lin Zexu surveyed again, building double storage dams at Huangjin Dam on the lake crest and at East Mound, raising 2,880 zhang of embankment so water could feed the lake.

sentences.zh: 又建減水石壩二於湖之東堤，俾可宣洩暴漲。

translations.literal: They also built two stone flood-release dams on the lake's east dike, so sudden rises could be discharged.
translations.idiomatic: Two stone spill dams on the eastern levee let sudden floods escape safely.

sentences.zh: 於入運處修復念七家古涵，以作水門，並建石閘以放水濟運。

translations.literal: At the place entering the transport canal they restored the ancient culvert of Nianqijia to serve as a water gate, and also built a stone lock to release water to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: At the canal junction they restored the old Nianqijia culvert as a sluice and added a stone lock to feed transport water.

sentences.zh: 是冬工竣，由涵引水出，竟能倒漾上行數十里，軍船得銜尾而南。

translations.literal: That winter the work was completed; water led out through the culvert could actually back-surge upstream for several tens of li, and military grain ships could follow nose to tail southward.
translations.idiomatic: When work finished that winter, water through the culvert backed upstream for dozens of li, and grain junks could sail south in close procession.

sentences.zh: 越二年，溜勢變遷，河形灣曲，復移建黃泥閘於迤上二百丈，改為正越二閘，中建磯心，並改張官渡迤下六十里呂城閘為正越二閘，以利漕行。

translations.literal: After two years the current's momentum shifted; the river form bent and curved; Huangni Lock was again moved and built two hundred zhang further upstream, changed to main-and-overflow two locks with a rock core built in the middle; and Lücheng Lock sixty li below Zhanggu Ferry was also changed to main-and-overflow two locks, to benefit grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later shifting currents bent the channel, so Huangni Lock was moved two hundred zhang upstream as paired main and spill locks with a rock core, and Lücheng Lock sixty li below Zhanggu was rebuilt the same way to ease grain traffic.

sentences.zh: 十五年，移築囊沙引渠沙壩於西河漘外，以資收蓄，從東河總督吳邦慶請也。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Nangsha intake channel's sand dam was moved and built outside the west river bank slope to aid collection and storage, following Eastern River Governor-General Wu Bangqing's request.
translations.idiomatic: Year fifteen, on Governor Wu Bangqing's request, the Nangsha intake sand dam was rebuilt beyond the west bank to improve storage.

sentences.zh: 十八年，運河淺阻，用河督栗毓美言，暫閉臨清閘，於閘外添築草壩九，節節擎蓄，於韓庄閘上硃姬庄迤南筑攔河大壩一，俾上游各泉及運河南注之水，並攔入微山湖。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Grand Canal was shallow and obstructed; following River Director Li Yumei's words, Linqing Lock was temporarily closed; outside the lock nine sod dams were added and built section by section to lift and store water; above Hanzhuang Lock south of Zhujizhuang one great river-blocking dam was built, so that various springs upstream and south-flowing water of the transport canal were all blocked into Weishan Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Year eighteen, with the canal shoaled, Director Li Yumei's plan closed Linqing Lock, added nine sod dams below it to pond water in stages, and built a great barrier south of Zhujizhuang above Hanzhuang to divert springs and southbound canal flow into Weishan Lake.

sentences.zh: 定收瀦濟運章程六。

translations.literal: Six regulations for collecting impoundment to aid transport were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Six rules were issued for impounding water to feed transport.

sentences.zh: 十九年，毓美以戴村壩卑矮，致汶水多旁泄，照舊制增高之。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Yumei, because Daicun Dam was low and short, causing Wen River water to leak aside in many places, raised it according to the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Year nineteen Yumei raised low Daicun Dam to the old height to stop Wen River water escaping sideways.

sentences.zh: 初，給事中成觀言淮、揚芒稻閘、人字河不宜堵壩，阻水去路，下陶澍等議。

translations.literal: Earlier, Censor Cheng Guan said the Huai-Yang Mangdao Lock and Renzi River should not have dams blocked, obstructing water's exit route; the matter was sent to Tao Shu and others for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Censor Cheng Guan argued that dams on the Huai-Yang Mangdao lock and Renzi River would block outflow, and the case went to Tao Shu and colleagues.

sentences.zh: 至是覆稱：「此壩蓄水由來已久，並不攔阻眾水歸江，不得輕議更張。」

translations.literal: At this time the reply stated: "These dams' water storage has a long history and do not block and obstruct all waters returning to the Yangtze; one must not lightly deliberate changing them."
translations.idiomatic: They now replied: "These dams have stored water for a long time and do not block the various waters from returning to the Yangtze; changes should not be lightly discussed."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court concurred.

sentences.zh: 時衛河淺澀，難以濟運。

translations.literal: At that time the Wei River was shallow and sluggish, hard to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei River had run so low that it could barely feed the transport canal.

sentences.zh: 東撫經額布請變更三日濟運、一日灌田例。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Jing'e'bu requested changing the rule of three days aiding transport and one day irrigating fields.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Jing'e'bu asked to revise the rule giving transport three days of water to one for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 詔將百門泉、小丹河各官渠官閘一律暢開，暫避民渠民閘，如有賣水阻運盜挖情弊，即行嚴懲。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that at Baimen Spring and the Xiaodan River all official canals and official locks be opened freely throughout, temporarily avoiding private canals and private locks; if there were abuses of selling water, obstructing transport, or illicit digging, punishment was to be severe at once.
translations.idiomatic: An edict opened every official canal and lock on the Baimen Spring and Xiaodan River lines, bypassing private works for the moment, and promised harsh punishment for selling water, blocking transport, or illegal diversions.

sentences.zh: 明年，漕督硃澍復言：「衛河不能下注，有妨運道。」

translations.literal: The next year Grain Transport Director Zhu Shu again said: "The Wei River cannot pour down, harming the transport route."
translations.idiomatic: The following year Grain Director Zhu Shu again said: "The Wei River cannot flow downstream, and this obstructs the transport route."

sentences.zh: 命河督文沖、豫撫牛鑒察勘。

translations.literal: The order went to River Director Wen Chong and Henan Governor Niu Jian to inspect and survey.
translations.idiomatic: River Director Wen Chong and Henan Governor Niu Jian were told to investigate.

sentences.zh: 文沖等言：「衛河需水之際，正民田待溉之時。

translations.literal: Wen Chong and others said: "When the Wei River needs water is precisely when the people's fields await irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Chong and the others said: "The time when the Wei River needs water is precisely the time when the people's fields await irrigation.

sentences.zh: 民以食為天，斷不能視田禾之枯槁置之不問。

translations.literal: The people take food as Heaven; one absolutely cannot watch field grain wither and set it aside without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The people take food as Heaven; we absolutely cannot look on while the crops wither and ignore them.

sentences.zh: 嗣後如雨澤愆期，衛河微弱，船行稍遲，毋庸變通舊章。

translations.literal: Hereafter, if rain and moisture are delayed beyond season and the Wei River is weak, and ships travel slightly late, there is no need to alter the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter, if the rains are delayed, the Wei River weak, and boat travel only somewhat slow, there is no need to alter the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 倘天時亢旱，糧船阻滯日久，是漕運尤重於民田，應暫閉民渠民閘，以利漕運。」

translations.literal: If heaven's seasons are severely drought-dry and grain ships are obstructed and delayed for many days, then grain transport is especially heavier than the people's fields; private canals and private locks should temporarily be closed to benefit grain transport."
translations.idiomatic: But if Heaven's season is severely dry and grain boats are obstructed for a long time, then grain transport is still more important than the people's fields, and the people's channels and locks should be temporarily closed to benefit grain transport."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，甘泉閘河撐堤潰塌三十餘丈，河決豐縣，山東被淹，運河漫水，漕艘改由湖陂行。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, at Ganquan Lock the river braced the dike and it collapsed for more than thirty zhang; the river breached at Feng County, Shandong was inundated, the Grand Canal flooded, and grain ships were changed to route through lake marshes.
translations.idiomatic: Xianfeng year one, thirty zhang of levee at Ganquan Lock gave way; the Yellow River broke at Feng County, flooded Shandong, drowned the canal, and grain ships were rerouted across lake flats.

sentences.zh: 先是戶部尚書孫瑞珍言十字河為全漕之害，若於河西改寬新河，以舊河為囊沙，於彭口作滾壩，納濁水而漾清流，漕船無阻，可省起剝費二十萬。

translations.literal: Earlier Household Minister Sun Ruizhen said Shizi River was the harm to the whole grain transport; if west of the river a new river were widened and cut, the old river used as sand-trap Nangsha, and at Pengkou a roller dam built to admit muddy water while clear water rippled, grain ships would be unimpeded and lighterage costs of two hundred thousand could be saved.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Household Minister Sun Ruizhen had said that the Cross River was the chief harm to all grain transport: if a wider new channel were cut west of the river, using the old river as a sand pouch, and a rolling dam were built at Pengkou to take in muddy water and ripple out a clear flow, grain boats would have no obstruction and two hundred thousand taels in lightering expenses could be saved.

sentences.zh: 下東河總督顏以燠議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to Eastern River Governor-General Yan Yixun for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The plan went to Eastern River Governor Yan Yixun for review.

sentences.zh: 至是以燠言：「改挖新河事無把握，無庸輕議更張。」

translations.literal: At this time Yixun said: "Cutting a new river has no certainty of success; there is no need lightly to deliberate changing the plan."
translations.idiomatic: Yixun now said: "There is no certainty in changing to dig a new channel; there is no need lightly to discuss altering the arrangement."

sentences.zh: 報聞。

translations.literal: Acknowledgment was reported.
translations.idiomatic: The court took note.

sentences.zh: 二年，決北運河北寺庄堤，命尚書賈楨、侍郎李鈞勘堵，並改次年漕糧由海道運津。

translations.literal: In the second year the Northern Grand Canal's Beisizhuang dike breached; Ministers Jia Zhen and Vice Minister Li Jun were ordered to survey and block it, and the next year's grain tribute was changed to transport by sea route to Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Year two the Beisizhuang levee on the northern canal broke; Ministers Jia Zhen and Li Jun were sent to seal it, and the next year's tribute grain was ordered by sea to Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 自是遂以海運為常。

translations.literal: From this sea transport became the regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: Sea transport thereafter became routine.

sentences.zh: 同治而後，更以輪舶由海轉運，費省而程速，雖分江北漕糧試行河運，然分者什一，藉保運道而已。

translations.literal: After Tongzhi, steamships were further used for sea transshipment, saving expense and speeding the journey; although a portion of Jiangbei grain tribute trial-ran river transport, the divided portion was one in ten, merely borrowing strength to preserve the transport route.
translations.idiomatic: After Tongzhi steamers carried grain by sea more cheaply and quickly; a tenth of Jiangbei tribute still trial-ran the canal, mainly to keep the route alive.

sentences.zh: 五年，銅瓦廂河決，穿運而東，堤埝沖潰。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Yellow River breached at Tongwaxiang, pierced east through the transport canal, and dike embankments were washed away.
translations.idiomatic: Year five the river broke at Tongwaxiang, cut east through the canal, and smashed the levees.

sentences.zh: 時軍事正棘，僅堵築張秋以北兩岸缺口。

translations.literal: At that time military affairs were urgently pressing; only gaps on both banks north of Zhangqiu were blocked and built up.
translations.idiomatic: With war urgent, crews could only patch breaches on both banks north of Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 民埝殘缺處，先作裹頭護埽，黃流倒漾處築壩收束，未遑他顧也。

translations.literal: Where civilian embankments were broken and missing, wrapped-head protective revetment was first made; where Yellow River flow backed and surged, dams were built to gather and restrain—there was no leisure to attend to other matters.
translations.idiomatic: Broken civilian levees got emergency revetment heads; where muddy water backed up, barrier dams were thrown up—nothing more could be done.

sentences.zh: 十年，決淮揚馬棚灣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year there was a breach at Huai-Yang Mapeng Bay.
translations.idiomatic: Year ten brought a breach at Mapeng Bay on the Huai-Yang line.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，決清水潭。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi there was a breach at Qingshuitan.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhi year five the river broke at Qingshuitan.

sentences.zh: 八年，河決蘭陽，漫水下注，運河堤埝殘缺更甚。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the river breached at Lanyang; spreading water poured down, and the Grand Canal's dike embankments were broken and missing still more severely.
translations.idiomatic: Year eight a break at Lanyang sent floodwater down the line, leaving the canal levees even more shattered.

sentences.zh: 自張秋以北，別無來源，歷年惟借黃濟運而已。

translations.literal: From Zhangqiu northward there is no other source; year after year one could only borrow Yellow River water to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: North of Zhangqiu there was no other water source; year after year transport relied solely on Yellow River water.

sentences.zh: 九年，漕督張之萬請於黃流穿運處堅築南北兩堤，酌留運口為漕船出入門戶，並築草壩，平時堵閉以免倒灌。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Grain Transport Director Zhang Zhiwan requested firmly building north and south dikes where Yellow River flow pierced the transport canal, appropriately leaving a transport mouth as gate and doorway for grain ships to enter and exit, and also building sod dams, normally blocked and closed to avoid backflow.
translations.idiomatic: Year nine Director Zhang Zhiwan asked for solid north and south dikes where the Yellow River crossed the canal, a controlled mouth for grain ships, and sod dams kept closed against backflow in normal times.

sentences.zh: 已下所司議，之萬旋改撫江蘇，繼任張兆棟以「既築堤束水留口門，又築壩堵閉，恐過水稍滯，而上游一氣奔注，新築堤閘難當衝激。

translations.literal: It had been sent to the responsible offices for deliberation; Zhiwan soon was transferred to govern Jiangsu, and his successor Zhang Zhaodong said: "Having built dikes to bind water yet leaving a mouth opening, and also building dams to block and close—one fears passing water will be slightly sluggish, while upstream in one breath rushes down, and newly built dikes and locks will be hard pressed to withstand the rush and strike.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal had been sent down to the responsible offices for deliberation, and Zhang Zhiwan was soon transferred to be governor of Jiangsu. His successor Zhang Zhaodong considered: "Since dikes have been built to bind the water while leaving a gate, and dams have also been built to close it off, I fear that the passage of water will become somewhat sluggish, while the upstream flow rushes down all at once and the newly built dikes and locks will not withstand the impact.

sentences.zh: 設奪運北趨，則東昌、臨清暨天津、河間，淹沒在所必至，北路衛河亦將廢壞。

translations.literal: If it seizes the transport route and rushes north, then Dongchang, Linqing, and Tianjin and Hejian will be inundated as a matter that must arrive; the northern route's Wei River will also be ruined and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: If it seizes the canal and runs north, Dongchang, Linqing, Tianjin, and Hejian will inevitably be inundated, and the northern Wei River route will also be ruined.

sentences.zh: 惟有於鄆城沮河一帶遏黃東流，即以保南路之運道，於張秋、八里廟等處疏運河之淤墊，即以通北上之漕行，較之築堤束水，稍有實際」。

translations.literal: Only at the Yuncheng Ju River stretch to check Yellow River eastward flow, thereby preserving the southern route's transport route; at Zhangqiu, Bali Temple, and other places to dredge the transport canal's silt padding, thereby opening northbound grain transport—compared with building dikes to bind water, this has somewhat more practical effect."
translations.idiomatic: The only course is to block the Yellow River's eastward flow around Yuncheng's Ju River, thereby protecting the southern transport route, and to dredge the canal's silt at Zhangqiu, Bali Temple, and elsewhere, thereby opening the northbound grain passage. Compared with building dikes to bind the water, this has somewhat more practical substance."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: Imperial approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，侯家林河決，直注南陽、昭陽等湖，鄆城幾為澤國。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the river breached at Houjialin, pouring straight into Nanyang, Zhaoyang, and other lakes; Yuncheng nearly became a marsh country.
translations.idiomatic: Year ten the river broke at Houjialin and poured into Nanyang, Zhaoyang, and neighboring lakes until Yuncheng nearly became a swamp.

sentences.zh: 漕督蘇鳳文言：「安山以北，運河全賴汶水分流，至臨清以上，始得衛水之助。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Director Su Fengwen said: "North of Anshan the Grand Canal wholly relies on Wen River divided flow; only above Linqing does it obtain the Wei River's aid.
